Commissions.note: A rate here is the fallback for an offer whose vendor sent no commission of its own. Where the vendor does state one, that figure is what the sale uses, and the Reported tab shows it. A commission may only break a tie between offers already equal on price and on obligatory extras; it can never be the reason a visitor is shown a dearer boat.

Settings.title: Marketplace settings

vendor.title: The provider's own schedule
vendor.hint: Each quote follows the instalments the provider returned for that yacht and those dates, including its own balance due date. Providers differ, so the percentage differs from booking to booking.

marketplace.title: Our own policy
marketplace.hint: Every quote uses the percentage below and the provider's schedule is ignored entirely, its due date included.

leadTime.toggle: Require full payment for charters starting soon
leadTime.hint: A floor on whichever plan is selected above, never a third plan of its own. Switched off, a provider's 30% stands even on a charter leaving tomorrow.
leadTime.daysError: Enter a whole number of days between 0 and 365.

preference.hint: Which vendor wins when availability, price and mandatory fees are equal. It never overrides a cheaper offer: it only settles a tie.
preference.rebuildNote: Applies to new quotes and the availability calendar immediately. Catalogue cards are rebuilt in the background right after the save, which takes well under a minute.

currency.toggle: Show prices in the visitor's own currency
currency.hint: Display only. A booking is settled in the currency it was priced in, and the payment screen states the amount that will actually be charged whenever the two differ. Converted figures are marked as approximate: reference rates are not what a card network applies. Prices stay in the vendor's currency whenever the rates have gone stale.

ranking.reliabilityToggle: Break a tie on how often a provider answers
ranking.reliabilityHint: Only where price, obligatory extras and commission are all equal. Skipped for any pair where either provider has too few asks in the window to measure, so a newly connected vendor is never ranked down for its silence. The figures are on the Sync History page.
ranking.catalogueToggle: Show the charter rate on cards
ranking.catalogueHint: Off, a card shows the all-in total. On, it shows the charter rate with the obligatory extras named beneath it, and the sort, the price filter and the slider all follow the same figure. Independent of the switch above: what a card advertises and which vendor we sell through are separate decisions.
ranking.hint: Off, the vendor whose all-in total is lower wins, which is what the guest actually pays. On, the charter rate decides and the obligatory extras only settle a tie on it. Ranking on the rate can pick the charter that costs the guest more overall.

referral.hint: What a referral pays, in euro. The figures the Referrals page quotes come from here.
referral.appliesNext: Applies to referrals credited from now on. Credit already granted keeps the amount and expiry it was given.

nameSearch.toggle: Show the free-text field in the search bar
nameSearch.hint: A testing aid rather than part of the design. Switched on, the yacht search bar gains a field that matches a boat's name, model, builder, charter company or base, word by word and in any order.

Settings.appliesNext: Applies to new quotes. A quote a customer is already holding keeps the policy it was priced under.
